timeline.summary: Time Technoplast received PESO approval for 250-litre Type IV composite hydrogen cylinders for onboard applications.
CARE Ratings issued Q4FY26 monitoring report confirming ₹443.59 Cr utilized out of ₹800 Cr QIP proceeds with no material deviations.

Time Technoplast Ltd. scheduled a Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call on May 28, 2026, at 16:00 IST with Mr. Bharat Kumar Vageria, Mr. Raghupathy Thyagarajan, Mr. Naveen Jain, Mr. Vishal Jain, Mr. Sandip Modi, Mr. Heman Soni, and Mr. Himanshu Upadhyay.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,676.67 Cr (+14.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹131.84 Cr (+20.4% YoY).
Time Technoplast released its investor presentation for Q4 & FY2026, reporting a 14.3% YoY rise in quarterly revenue and 20.4% growth in PAT.
Bharat Kumar Vageria, Managing Director, shared the Q4 & FY2026 Results conference call audio recording link on May 29, 2026.
Time Technoplast filed the transcript of its Q4 & FY2026 results conference call held on May 29, 2026.
Time Technoplast Limited invites participants to a Q2 & H1FY27 Earnings Conference Call on Friday, 6 November 2026 at 16:00 IST.
